coverage_notes.note: The copyright notice uses symbolic <year> and <owner> placeholders; no values are supplied.
Source-form and binary-form redistribution duties are distinct and apply only to their respective forms.
The warranty and liability disclaimer is not an activity constraint and is excluded.

rules.source_excerpt:
Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions are met:
rules.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause; redistribution of the software in source form, with or without modification. The source-form notice duty is specified in lines 9–10.
rules.condition_explanation: source_redistribution_conditions_met means retaining the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in source-code redistributions.

obligation_items.content: Retain the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in the source-code redistribution.
obligation_items.trigger: when redistributing the software in source-code form

rules.source_excerpt:
Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions are met:
rules.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause; redistribution of the software in binary form, with or without modification. The binary-form notice duty is specified in lines 12–14.
rules.condition_explanation: binary_redistribution_conditions_met means reproducing the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution.

obligation_items.content: Reproduce the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution.
obligation_items.object: documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution
obligation_items.trigger: when redistributing the software in binary form

rules.source_excerpt:
Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions are met:
rules.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause; use of the software in source or binary form, with or without modification. The text makes redistribution subject to form-specific notice conditions; it does not state a separate notice duty for use without redistribution.
rules.condition_explanation: The express permission covers use in source and binary forms, with or without modification. Redistribution conditions apply when the corresponding redistribution occurs.

rules.source_excerpt:
Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions are met:
rules.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause; modification is included in the permission for use and redistribution with or without modification. Form-specific notice duties apply upon corresponding redistribution.
rules.condition_explanation: The express permission covers activity with or without modification. Redistribution conditions apply when the corresponding source- or binary-form redistribution occurs.

rules.source_excerpt:
1. Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright notice, this
   list of conditions and the following disclaimer.
rules.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause, condition 1; source-code redistributions must retain the specified materials.
rules.condition_explanation: source_notice_materials_retained means the source-code redistribution retains the above copyright notice, the list of conditions, and the disclaimer. The copyright line contains symbolic <year> and <owner> placeholders.

obligation_items.content: Retain the above copyright notice, the list of conditions, and the disclaimer.
obligation_items.trigger: when redistributing the software in source-code form

rules.source_excerpt:
2. Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright notice,
   this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the documentation
   and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
rules.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause, condition 2; binary-form redistributions must reproduce the specified materials in accompanying documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
rules.condition_explanation: binary_notice_materials_reproduced means reproducing the above copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution. The copyright line contains symbolic <year> and <owner> placeholders.

obligation_items.content: Reproduce the above copyright notice, the list of conditions, and the disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
obligation_items.object: documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution
obligation_items.trigger: when redistributing the software in binary form
